Compose and Stage gate-collector fix under STAGE111-ROLLBACK-RTO-REGRESSION-20261109 after real Stage run 42552683248 (release pantheon-20261108-111, dev bdd2b8e54) passed Stage 1-2 but failed Stage 3 with ROLLBACK_VERIFICATION_FAILED (rollback 135.651s > 120s RTO gate; drain=10.683s, baseline_up=65.070s, owners_healthy=41.221s, readyz_200=6.169s, readback=12.506s). Root causes and fixes without loosening the 120s RTO gate or modifying product images/release declarations: (1) drain (10.683s -> ~0.8s): lifecycle-projector runs python as PID 1 without a SIGTERM handler and waited out the 10s default stop timeout on compose rm -fsv; added stop_signal: SIGINT and stop_grace_period: 2s in Stage and Prod compose; (2) baseline_up (65.070s -> ~16-22s): Docker Compose v2 recreateContainer stops old containers across 4 depends_on waves before starting any replacement container (causing the observed 30-40s gap between Created 02:58:47Z and StartedAt 02:59:28-38Z), where paper-signal-producer lacked stop_signal: SIGINT and blocked on its 30s stop_grace_period (02:58:58Z -> 02:59:28Z), other Python-PID-1 services (runtime-manager, lineage-read, telemetry, agora-interaction-worker) lacked stop_signal: SIGINT, and sh -c uvicorn wrappers waited 10s per wave; added stop_signal: SIGINT to all Python-PID-1 services and bounded stop_grace_period to 2s (5s on paper-fleet-reconciler and paper-signal-producer) in both Stage and Prod compose; (3) owners_healthy (41.221s -> ~16-20s): paper-signal-producer had healthcheck.interval: 30s (delaying Docker starting->healthy transition by 30s after start) and _wait_product_owners ran 24 sequential docker compose ps -q calls (~10.8s of YAML parsing) on every sample; lowered healthcheck.interval to 5s (start_period: 5s on paper workers) across all 17 product owners with healthchecks in Stage and Prod compose (preserving 10s/15s on governance and deployment) and cached known_cids across consecutive samples in _wait_product_owners; (4) readyz_200 (6.169s -> ~0.5-2.0s): lowered default _wait_bff_ready polling interval from 3s to 1s; (5) readback (12.506s -> ~1.5-2.5s): reused last_verified_cids from _wait_product_owners before docker inspect instead of repeating 24 sequential docker compose ps -q calls. Expected total Stage rollback duration: ~35-48s (saving ~90s, well under the unchanged 120s RTO gate).
